You are the D-package Python worker implementation lane. Work ONLY in worktree /home/lousuan/lansee/openvela/contest2026_483_yuanxinshixisheng/.worktrees/mvp-d (branch feature/mvp-assessments). Use absolute `workdir` for every bash call (base: /home/lousuan/lansee/openvela/contest2026_483_yuanxinshixisheng/.worktrees/mvp-d/backend/worker-python); NEVER chain `cd`; never touch anything outside this worktree (no other .worktrees, no project-root .coordination, no PG ports 5432/55432/55433/55436). Do NOT git commit. Do NOT start long-running processes.

# Objective
Implement three Python worker handlers in backend/worker-python — assessment.analyze, identity.enroll, plan.generate (M4 plan generation is D's) — with provider adapter boundaries (controlled doubles + Aliyun-shaped config boundary, production fail-closed), plus pytest suites against real PG. Python 3.12, SQLAlchemy Core 2.x (no ORM), psycopg3, pydantic2, jsonschema draft 2020-12.

# Authoritative references (read first)
- backend/doc/后端详细设计-V1-MVP.md §7.1 (task state machine), §7.2 (plan state machine), §8.1 (lock order, worker rules), §9.1-9.4 (job contract, claim/complete, identity enrollment & reconciliation, report publication & plan handoff)
- backend/doc/数据架构设计-V1-五模块-MVP.md T01/T05/T06/T11/T12 sections
- backend/doc/人脸服务调研与推荐方案-V1-MVP.md §4 (Aliyun APIs: SearchFace/AddFaceEntity/AddFace/CompareFace/DetectLivingFace), §6 (field guidance)
- backend/worker-python/README.md (write-boundary hard constraints) and src/mvp_worker/handlers/README.md (handler extension guide — follow exactly)
- Code to study: src/mvp_worker/handlers/__init__.py (Handler protocol, JobFailed, UnsupportedPayload, HandlerResult, BusinessTx, register), handlers/system_echo.py (reference handler), runtime/complete.py (complete_success runs handler business_tx INSIDE the same tx as the generation-guarded job completion; StaleGeneration), runtime/claim.py, runtime/renew.py (LostLease/abort_event), runtime/expire.py, media/repository.py, media/storage.py (build_object_key, FilesystemStorageDouble), config.py (WorkerConfig env names), tests/conftest.py (test_dsn/engine/enqueue/fetch_job/clean_tables fixtures).
- Contracts (READ-ONLY, must not modify): backend/contracts/schemas/payload-assessment-analyze.json {schema_version const 1, assessment_id uuid, processing_revision bigint-string, additionalProperties false}; payload-identity-enroll.json {schema_version, correlation_id uuid, assessment_id, photo_version, processing_revision, images{front,left,right: media uuids}, provider_config_revision}; payload-plan-generate.json {schema_version, plan_id, generation_revision}. job-async_jobs.json defines the T12 row/owner_type/dedup shapes. Validate payloads with jsonschema against these files (locate via MVP_CONTRACTS_DIR env, default repo backend/contracts).

# DB facts (from V1/V2 migrations — read backend/web-java/src/main/resources/db/migration/*.sql for exact DDL)
- skin_assessments T05: worker-owned columns: status (analyzing/needs_retake/report_ready/failed transitions), member_id, identity_result, report_id, report_summary, report_payload, report_photo_version, report_ready_at, failure_code, failure_detail. Java-owned (NEVER write): current_photo_version, photo_versions, processing_revision, source_request_id, gimbal_id. CHECK: status='report_ready' requires member_id+report_id+report_payload+report_photo_version all non-null. photo_versions shape: {"schema_version":1,"versions":[{"version":N,"images":{"front","left","right":media-uuids},"quality":{"status","required_views"}}]}.
- care_plans T06: worker-owned generation columns: generation_status (waiting_inputs/generating/ready/failed), input_photo_version, generation_revision, input_snapshot, plan_summary, plan_payload, target_count, failure_detail. NEVER write completed_count/completed_at/progress_revision (K ledger belongs to C). CHECK: ready requires target_count>0 AND plan_payload non-null; uq_plan_assessment UNIQUE(assessment_id).
- members T01: worker-owned reliable archiving: identity_namespace+face_subject_ref (partial unique uq_members_identity), profile, identity_summary, created_from_assessment_id, status. Never write member_access_grants (T02).
- media_objects T11: worker may create rows for its own task's result images (purpose='assessment_result', assessment_id, photo_version, member_id, state, content_type, byte_size, content_hash, storage_metadata {schema_version integer,...}, uploader_type='worker').
- async_jobs T12: partial unique index uq_job_identity_enroll ON async_jobs(owner_id) WHERE job_type='identity.enroll' AND status IN ('queued','running','failed') — one pending enrollment per namespace owner. payload CHECK requires schema_version integer (object form). job_type enum incl. assessment.analyze/identity.enroll/plan.generate. owner_type enum incl. assessment/plan/identity_namespace.
- gimbals T03 current_assessment_id: worker NEVER writes it. microcrystals T04 capabilities/latest_observation/observed_at: read-only for capability matching.

# Write scope
- NEW modules under src/mvp_worker/handlers/: assessment_analyze.py, identity_enroll.py, plan_generate.py; NEW support package src/mvp_worker/handlers/dshared/ (or similar D-owned namespace): providers.py (face/skin/plan ports + doubles + aliyun-shaped boundary + factory), dconfig.py (D env config), denqueue.py (worker-side job insert helper), dmedia.py (result-image archival), dsql.py if useful.
- MODIFY handlers/__init__.py ONLY by appending the three register(...) lines at the registration section end (authorized: "仅添加 D 条目").
- NEW tests: tests/test_assessment_analyze.py, test_identity_enroll.py, test_plan_generate.py, tests/d_support.py (seeding/cleanup helpers). Do NOT edit tests/conftest.py or any runtime/ file; if something seems to require it, document instead.
- FORBIDDEN: changes to backend/contracts, migrations, runtime/*, media/*, health/*, config.py, db.py, __main__.py, loop mechanics, deploy/, docs, web-java. SQL: single-table statements only (SQLAlchemy Core text() or table objects), no JOINs/correlated subqueries; field-level UPDATEs with revision guards; multiple bounded SELECTs in one tx are fine. Lock order when multiple rows: business rows first then T12 (runtime handles T12); FOR UPDATE on T05/T06 inside business_tx.

# Handler semantics (authoritative spec — implements DD §7/§9)
Shared rules: validate() = strict jsonschema against the payload file (error messages contain json_path + keyword only, NEVER payload values → UnsupportedPayload). handle(): check ctx.abort_event at every external-call boundary; if set → return None immediately (result abandoned). All business writes go through HandlerResult(business_tx=fn) so they commit atomically with the generation-guarded job completion (complete_success). Stale input (T05.processing_revision != payload processing_revision, or T06.generation_revision != payload generation_revision) → NO writes, return None → job completes succeeded (legitimately obsolete; document). Transient dependency failures → raise JobFailed(code, bounded message ≤200 chars, retryable=True). Terminal path: when claim row shows attempt_count >= max_attempts (this is the last allowed attempt) and failure is unavoidable, FIRST write T05 status='failed' + failure_code + failure_detail {"retryable":false,"reason":...} (guarded UPDATE WHERE id=:id AND processing_revision=:rev AND status IN ('queued','analyzing')) in a short own transaction, THEN raise JobFailed(retryable=False). Never log payloads/images/secrets (use JobRow.log_fields()).

## assessment.analyze (owner_type=assessment, owner_id=assessment_id, input_revision=processing_revision, dedup assessment:{id}:{rev})
1. Load T05 (single SELECT). Missing → JobFailed('ASSESSMENT_NOT_FOUND', retryable=False). Stale revision → no-op succeed. photo versions entry for current_photo_version → media ids {front,left,right}; load each media row (media/repository.get_media) and bytes via storage (media/storage.py) — missing/failed object → retryable (DEPENDENCY) / terminal rules above with failure_code 'SOURCE_IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE'.
2. Mark analyzing (own short tx): UPDATE T05 SET status='analyzing', updated_at=now() WHERE id=:id AND processing_revision=:rev AND status IN ('queued','analyzing') — 0 rows → stale/no-op succeed.
3. Face port: quality(3 views) + same_person(3 views). Rejected → business_tx: UPDATE T05 SET status='needs_retake', photo_versions=jsonb_set(latest version quality → {"status":"needs_retake","required_views":[...]})... WAIT: photo_versions is Java-owned. Correction — you may NOT rewrite photo_versions. Instead store retake requirement in worker-owned columns: identity_result {"schema_version":1,"classification":"quality_rejected"|"not_same_person","required_views":[...],"detail":...} and status='needs_retake'. (Java M3-A03 derives requiredViews from photo_versions quality; since worker can't write it, ALSO write failure_code='QUALITY_REJECTED'/'NOT_SAME_PERSON' and put required_views inside failure_detail {"retryable":false,"required_views":[...]} — document this boundary; Java lane projects requiredViews from photo_versions quality OR failure_detail.required_views — I will reconcile. Keep required_views a bounded enum subset of [front,left,right].) Same-person failure → required_views = all three.
4. Skin port: analyze(current version images) → {conclusion, metrics[{name,value,unit}], description, result_images[{ref,bytes or provider_uri,caption}]} — STRICT validation against approved metrics baseline (dconfig: MVP_SKIN_METRICS_BASELINE JSON {"schema_version":1,"metrics":[{"name","unit","min","max"}]} env or default constant documented as MVP controlled baseline): unknown metric name/unit or out-of-range value or malformed shape → terminal failure_code 'PROVIDER_CONTRACT_VIOLATION' (never publish non-whitelisted). Transient → retryable.
5. Result image archival BEFORE publication: for each result image — check existing T11 rows (single SELECT WHERE assessment_id=:id AND photo_version=:v AND purpose='assessment_result') and reuse by storage_metadata->>'provider_ref' match (idempotent retries, no orphan duplication); else create row pending → storage put via build_object_key(environment,'assessment_result',media_id) → UPDATE row to available with content_type (image/png etc whitelist), byte_size, content_hash sha256, storage_metadata {"schema_version":1,"provider_ref":...}. Size cap from dconfig (default 10MiB). Any archival failure → no publication; retryable/terminal rules (failure_code 'RESULT_ARCHIVE_FAILED').
6. Identity port 1:N search(current images, namespace): classifications —
   - MATCHED(face_subject_ref): resolve member via SELECT id FROM members WHERE identity_namespace=:ns AND face_subject_ref=:ref (uses uq_members_identity). Row missing (provider visibility lag) → retryable up to budget, terminal failure_code 'MEMBER_NOT_VISIBLE'.
   - UNCERTAIN/AMBIGUOUS → business_tx: status='needs_retake', identity_result {"schema_version":1,"classification":"uncertain",...}, failure_code='IDENTITY_UNCERTAIN', failure_detail {"retryable":false,"required_views":["front","left","right"]}; NEVER create a member.
   - DEPENDENCY_FAILED → retryable (never treated as match/new).
   - RELIABLE_NEW → candidate_entity_id = deterministic uuid5(FIXED_NS=f988d041-6031-5120-8075-f90b6b05553e, "face-candidate:{ns}:{assessment_id}") (stable across retries). Persist phase first (own short tx, guarded): identity_result {"schema_version":1,"classification":"reliable_new","candidate_entity_id":...,"phase":"enroll_pending","correlation_id":...}. Then enqueue identity.enroll via denqueue in its OWN committed short tx: job_type identity.enroll, owner_type 'identity_namespace', owner_id = uuid5(FIXED_NS, "identity-namespace:{ns}") (namespace-level stable UUID per DD §11 — serializes the whole namespace via uq_job_identity_enroll; do NOT use per-person owner), input_revision = processing_revision, dedup_key "identity:{ns}:{candidate_entity_id}", payload per payload-identity-enroll.json (correlation_id deterministic uuid5("enroll-correlation:{ns}:{assessment_id}"), images = current version media ids, provider_config_revision from dconfig). IntegrityError on the partial unique index (slot occupied) OR dedup replay → WAIT: raise JobFailed('IDENTITY_ENROLLMENT_PENDING', retryable=True). On last attempt → terminal: T05 failed + failure_code 'IDENTITY_ENROLLMENT_TIMEOUT' (guarded) + JobFailed(retryable=False). After enroll completes, the re-run analyze cycle finds MATCHED via search (enroll guarantees visibility) and publishes.
7. Publish (single business_tx returned as HandlerResult): SELECT T05 ... FOR UPDATE; re-verify processing_revision==rev; if status='report_ready' already → no-op (idempotent). Writes: member_id, status='report_ready', report_id=uuid4, report_summary {"schema_version":1,"conclusion":...,"headline_metrics":[names only, bounded]}, report_payload {"schema_version":1,"conclusion","metrics":[validated whitelist],"description","images":[{"media_id","caption"}],"model_info":{"skin_provider","model_version"}} (model_info internal — Java projection drops it), report_photo_version=current_photo_version, report_ready_at=now, identity_result final {"schema_version":1,"classification":"matched"|"enrolled",...}; INSERT care_plans (id uuid4, assessment_id, member_id, generation_status 'waiting_inputs', input_photo_version=current_photo_version, generation_revision 0, input_snapshot {}, plan_summary {"schema_version":1,"source_report_id":...,"source_report_ready_at":...}) — uq_plan_assessment IntegrityError → treat as already-handed-off no-op (re-run idempotency); INSERT plan.generate job (owner_type 'plan', owner_id plan_id, input_revision 0, dedup "plan:{plan_id}:0", payload {"schema_version":1,"plan_id":str,"generation_revision":"0"}) — dedup conflict → replay no-op. All in the same tx as job success (runtime guarantees).

## identity.enroll (owner identity_namespace; dedup identity:{ns}:{candidate})
1. Load T05; stale check vs payload processing_revision AND payload photo_version == current_photo_version: input replaced by retake → DO NOT call provider, DO NOT attribute: no-op succeed, log (DD 9.3: old registration must not attach to new photos).
2. Persist pre-call phase (own short guarded tx): identity_result phase='enroll_started', provider_request_id = deterministic uuid5("enroll-request:{correlation_id}"), candidate_entity_id, correlation_id (so timeout reconciliation has a durable record before any external call).
3. External (lock-free): face port register_person(ns, candidate_entity_id, images, correlation_id, provider_request_id) — double: deterministic success unless test-injected fault; then MUST verify visibility: search-by-entity (double confirms) before returning success (DD: registration not confirmed visible → keep blocked). Timeout/unknown → reconcile: port.query_registration(correlation_id/provider_request_id) → registered → proceed; unknown & budget left → JobFailed('ENROLLMENT_RECONCILE_PENDING', retryable=True) (NEVER mint another candidate id / blind retry); budget exhausted → JobFailed retryable=False — row stays failed = slot REMAINS OCCUPIED per DD (managed reconciliation required; log alert; document recovery = after external reconciliation set job cancelled/succeeded via ops SQL).
4. Result business_tx: re-check T05 rev/photo_version (stale → skip T05 attribution; still create member if external succeeded — member exists unlinked, logged for controlled reconciliation, because provider index now has the person); INSERT members (id uuid4, identity_namespace=ns, face_subject_ref=candidate_entity_id, profile {}, identity_summary {"schema_version":1,"enrollment":{"correlation_id","provider_request_id","provider_config_revision","registered_at","source_assessment_id","photo_version"},"reference_media":{front,left,right}}, created_from_assessment_id=assessment_id, status 'active') — uq_members_identity IntegrityError → SELECT existing id (idempotent re-run); UPDATE T05 SET member_id=:mid, identity_result phase='enrolled'+member_id (guarded rev) only when not stale. NEVER write T02. Job succeeded atomically.

## plan.generate (owner plan, dedup plan:{id}:{rev})
1. Load T06. Missing → terminal 'PLAN_NOT_FOUND'. generation_status 'ready' → no-op succeed (never regenerate/update ready). 'failed' → no-op succeed (managed). Stale generation_revision → no-op succeed.
2. waiting_inputs: verify frozen report (single SELECT T05 by assessment_id: status='report_ready' AND report_payload non-null AND report_photo_version==T06.input_photo_version; else terminal 'REPORT_INPUT_INVALID' — should not happen). Capability gate: baseline from dconfig MVP_PLAN_CAPABILITY_BASELINE JSON {"schema_version":1,"capability_id","revision","parameter_ranges":{name:{unit,min,max}},"approved_regions":[...],"n_bounds":{"min","max"}} (ship a documented MVP controlled default; real device protocol pending — no invented treatment parameters beyond clearly-marked placeholder ranges). If baseline not configured → WAIT-hop. Scan T04 (bounded: SELECT id,capabilities,latest_observation,observed_at FROM microcrystals LIMIT 500): match = capabilities->>'capability_id'==baseline id AND (capabilities->>'revision')::int >= baseline revision AND latest_observation != '{}' (staleness window dconfig MVP_PLAN_CAPABILITY_STALE_SECONDS default 86400, 0=ignore). None → WAIT-hop.
   WAIT-hop (implements DD 7.2 "waiting tasks re-scheduled at wait-check interval" without burning attempt budget): business_tx: UPDATE T06 SET generation_revision=generation_revision+1, updated_at=now() WHERE id=:id AND generation_revision=:rev AND generation_status='waiting_inputs' (0 rows → concurrent change → no-op succeed) + denqueue successor plan.generate (input_revision=rev+1, dedup "plan:{id}:{rev+1}", available_at=now()+MVP_PLAN_WAIT_CHECK_SECONDS default 30) → current job succeeded. Document: wait hops increment generation_revision (needed for fresh dedup key); ready-freeze pins the final generation.
3. Capability satisfied → generating (own short guarded tx): UPDATE T06 SET generation_status='generating', input_snapshot={"schema_version":1,"report":{"assessment_id","report_id","report_photo_version"},"capability":{"microcrystal_id","capability_id","capability_revision","parameter_ranges":baseline ranges},"model":{"plan_provider","model_version","prompt_template_version"}}, updated_at=now() WHERE id AND generation_revision=:rev AND generation_status='waiting_inputs'. 0 rows → no-op succeed.
4. External: plan port generate(frozen report summary + input_snapshot) → candidate {description, steps[{step_id, region, parameters{name:value}}], target_count} — double: deterministic valid plan derived from baseline (documented placeholder content, clearly double-generated); faults injectable for tests.
5. STRICT validation (approved whitelist only, never arbitrary JSON): target_count integer within n_bounds (string forms rejected — must be JSON integer or bigint-string parseable to integer >0); steps non-empty; every region ∈ approved_regions; every parameter name ∈ parameter_ranges keys; each value within min/max and unit per baseline; no additional top-level/step keys beyond the declared shape. Invalid → retryable up to budget (LLM nondeterminism), last attempt → business_tx T06 generation_status='failed' + failure_detail {"code":"PLAN_VALIDATION_FAILED","retryable":false,"violations":[bounded json_paths only]} → JobFailed retryable=False. Never publish invalid as ready.
6. Publish business_tx: SELECT T06 FOR UPDATE; verify generation_status='generating' AND generation_revision=:rev (else no-op succeed — includes already-ready); UPDATE plan_payload {"schema_version":1,"description","steps":[normalized validated]}, plan_summary {"schema_version":1,"description"(bounded),"source_report_id","target_count":"<bigint string>"}, target_count=N, generation_status='ready', updated_at=now(). NEVER touch completed_count/completed_at/progress_revision; never write T07/T08; never release any execution occupancy; never write gimbals.

# Provider boundary & fail-closed (dconfig + providers)
- Ports (ABCs or Protocols): FacePort (quality, same_person, search_1n, register_person, query_registration), SkinPort (analyze), PlanPort (generate). Doubles: deterministic, configurable fault injection for tests (constructor params or extras), clearly named *Double, produce small synthetic PNG bytes for result images.
- Factory from env: MVP_D_FACE_PROVIDER / MVP_D_SKIN_PROVIDER / MVP_D_PLAN_PROVIDER ∈ {double, aliyun_face, aliyun_llm} default double; MVP_IDENTITY_NAMESPACE default "mvp-ns-1"; provider config revision MVP_D_PROVIDER_CONFIG_REVISION default "1".
- PRODUCTION FAIL-CLOSED: if WorkerConfig.environment == 'production' and any provider resolves to a Double → raise immediately (job fails DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE-style, retryable) — doubles never run in production. aliyun_* adapters: implement the adapter CLASS boundary per research doc (config env names for endpoint/AK/SK/DbName/model, method mapping documented to SearchFace/AddFaceEntity/AddFace/CompareFace + LLM contract) but WITHOUT real credentials/contract every call raises ProviderNotActivated (mapped to retryable DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE) — NO fabricated results, NO fake business effects. Document that real activation requires 总协调-authorized credentials + PoC.
- denqueue helper: INSERT INTO async_jobs (id,job_type,dedup_key,owner_type,owner_id,input_revision,payload,status,available_at,attempt_count,max_attempts,lease_revision) VALUES (uuid4,:jt,:dk,:ot,:oid,:rev,:payload::jsonb,'queued',COALESCE(:avail,now()),0,:max,0) ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id; no row → SELECT id by dedup_key (replayed=True); max_attempts mirrors WorkerConfig().retry_max_attempts; payload dicts always carry integer schema_version. Catch IntegrityError from uq_job_identity_enroll separately (slot-occupied WAIT path).

# Test environment (isolated, mandatory)
PG container mvp-d-pg running at 127.0.0.1:55437 (postgres/mvp_d_local). venv already at backend/worker-python/.venv. Run from workdir /home/lousuan/lansee/openvela/contest2026_483_yuanxinshixisheng/.worktrees/mvp-d/backend/worker-python with env: MVP_A_PG_DSN=postgresql://postgres:mvp_d_local@127.0.0.1:55437/postgres MVP_A_PG_HOST_PORT=55437 MVP_A_PG_USER=postgres MVP_A_PG_PASSWORD=mvp_d_local .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q. NEVER 55432. Do not set MVP_A_STORAGE_DEV_DIR for pytest (defaults are fine; use tmp dirs in tests if needed).
1. BASELINE FIRST (before edits): expect 47 tests green. If red, stop and report.
2. Implement; full suite green (47 + new), exit 0.

# Required test coverage (real PG via conftest fixtures; seed T03/T13/T05/T11/T06/T01/T04 rows in d_support with FK-safe cleanup)
- analyze: happy MATCHED → published (assert every T05 report column, T06 waiting_inputs row generation_revision=0, plan job queued dedup plan:{id}:0, analyze job succeeded lease/attempt sane); RELIABLE_NEW → enroll job enqueued (owner_type identity_namespace, owner_id = namespace uuid5, dedup, payload schema-valid) + analyze requeued retryable; run enroll then re-run analyze (reclaim) → MATCHED → published; namespace slot occupied (pre-seed pending enroll for another candidate) → analyze requeued retryable, no second enroll row; UNCERTAIN → needs_retake, failure_code IDENTITY_UNCERTAIN, required_views all three, NO members row; quality rejected → needs_retake + required_views subset; NOT same person → all views; stale processing_revision (bump T05 after enqueue) → job succeeded, T05 untouched; publish guard: flip T05 to needs_retake/new revision between handle and business_tx → no publication, job succeeds or StaleGeneration handled per runtime (assert no report columns written); result-image retry idempotence (run handle twice with forced retryable failure between) → no duplicate T11 assessment_result rows for same provider_ref; dependency failure retryable → job requeued with backoff, T05 stays analyzing; last-attempt terminal → T05 failed + failure_code set; metrics whitelist violation (injected) → terminal PROVIDER_CONTRACT_VIOLATION, nothing published; report_ready re-run → no-op (report columns byte-identical).
- enroll: happy → member created (identity_summary fields, created_from_assessment_id), T05 member_id linked, phase enrolled, job succeeded; re-run after success (reclaim scenario) → uq_members_identity conflict → existing member reused, no duplicate; stale input (retake bumped revision/photo_version) → no provider call (assert double call counter 0), no member, job succeeded no-op; register timeout then reconcile → query_registration returns registered → member created, register_person called exactly once; unrecoverable register failure → job failed terminal, slot STILL occupied (assert new enroll INSERT for another candidate violates uq_job_identity_enroll), T05 not linked; never writes member_access_grants (assert empty).
- plan: capability missing → wait-hop (generation_revision+1, successor job available_at delayed ~wait interval, current job succeeded, T06 still waiting_inputs); capability satisfied (seed T04 matching baseline) → generating → ready (target_count>0 within bounds, plan_payload validated shape, input_snapshot frozen incl. capability ids, plan_summary); K-protection: seed completed_count=5/completed_at/progress_revision=3 → after ready publish all three UNCHANGED; invalid outputs (injected: N=0, N=99999 out of bounds, unknown region, param out of range, extra property, non-integer N string garbage) → never ready; retry then last-attempt → T06 failed + failure_detail code; ready plan + re-run job → no-op, generation_revision & payload unchanged; stale generation_revision job → no-op; report input invalid (T05 not report_ready) → terminal; plan row missing → terminal; dedup: enqueue same plan:{id}:{rev} twice → single row.
- regression: A's 47 tests green incl. system.echo behavior and UNSUPPORTED_CONTRACT for unregistered types (notification.deliver/media.cleanup must remain unregistered → failed/UNSUPPORTED_CONTRACT quarantine).

# Reporting
Final message: files created/modified, baseline result, final pytest totals + exit code, provider/config env surface introduced, key decisions/deviations (esp. the photo_versions-vs-failure_detail required_views boundary, namespace owner uuid choice, wait-hop generation_revision semantics), anything needing coordination. Structured, complete, no whole-file pastes.

1: # mvp_worker — Python 后台异步任务 Worker（T12 运行时）
2: 
3: A 包交付：`async_jobs` 的领取/续租/过期回收/代次受控完成运行时、
4: `system.echo` handler、B/C/D handler 扩展点、媒体访问骨架、健康端点。

9: ## 运行保证：至少一次执行 + 代次控制
10: 
11: - **at-least-once**：崩溃/租约过期后任务会被再次领取，handler 可能重复执行。
12:   **不宣称 exactly-once**；重复落地由以下机制阻断：
13:   1. **领取代次** `lease_revision`：每次领取/回收 +1。所有状态写回（成功、
14:      失败、放弃）都是条件更新
15:      `WHERE id AND status='running' AND lease_owner AND lease_revision`，
16:      0 行 → `StaleGeneration`，旧领取者的一切结果作废。
17:   2. **成功事务顺序**（DD 8.1）：同一事务内**先**执行 handler 业务写回调
18:      （先锁业务行、持锁后复核业务 `input_revision` 仍是任务输入版本），
19:      **后**更新 `async_jobs → succeeded`；守卫失败 → 整体回滚，结果不发布。
20:   3. **回收器**：条件更新把过期 `running` 转回 `queued` 并 +代次，使旧领取者
21:      整体失效；绝不"查时间后无条件覆盖"。
22: - **重试**：可重试失败且 `attempt_count < max_attempts`（行上列值为准，
23:   Java 入队默认 5）→ 回 `queued`，指数退避
24:   `delay = min(base * 2^(attempt-1), cap) + U(0, 0.2*delay)`
25:   （dev 初值 base=5s、cap=300s）；否则 `failed` 留 `last_error`。
26: - **契约不认识不循环**：未知 job_type / 未注册 handler / payload
27:   schema_version 不符 / JSON Schema 校验失败 → 直接
28:   `failed` + `last_error.code=UNSUPPORTED_CONTRACT`，不重试。
29: 
30: ## 状态机（async_jobs.status）
31: 
32: ```
33:                  ┌──────────────── retryable & attempt<max ────────────────┐
34:                  │            （available_at = now + backoff+抖动）          │
35:  queued ──claim──▶ running ──┬─ handler ok + 代次守卫过 ──▶ succeeded(终态)  │
36:    ▲    (FOR UPDATE          ├─ 不可重试 / 尝试耗尽 ──▶ failed(终态)         │
37:    │    SKIP LOCKED)         ├─ 契约不认识 ──────────▶ failed(UNSUPPORTED)   │
38:    └────── recover ──────────┴─ 租约过期(未写回) ──────┘(回收器条件更新回 queued, 代次+1)
39: ```
40: 
41: - claim：单短事务 SELECT+UPDATE（提交后才做外部调用；不持 T12 等业务行）。
42: - renew：仅当代次匹配且原租约未到期才延长；失败 → `LostLease` →
43:   handler 协作式中止，结果**不提交**（放弃写回，等新代次）。
44: - stale 完成：业务写（含 media_objects）随事务回滚，绝不发布。
45: 
46: ## 写入边界（硬约束）
47: 
48: Worker 只写：
49: - `async_jobs` 的租约/状态/结果字段：`status, lease_owner, lease_until,
50:   lease_revision, attempt_count, available_at, last_error, finished_at`
51:   （+自维护的 `updated_at` 簿记列）；全部字段级条件 UPDATE，**禁整行 upsert**。
52: - 扩展点（B/C/D）：自己任务的 `media_objects` 行 + 设计中划给 Worker 的
53:   业务表字段（见 `src/mvp_worker/handlers/README.md`）。
54: - **永不写** `idempotency_requests`（T13 归 Java）；A 包 echo 只动 `async_jobs`。
55: 
56: ## CLI
57: 
58: ```bash
59: .venv/bin/python -m mvp_worker            # 运行循环 + 健康端点（SIGTERM/SIGINT 优雅停机）

9: ## 如何新增一个 handler（B/C/D）
10: 
11: 1. **契约先行**：在 `backend/contracts/schemas/payload-<job>.json` 定义/更新

15:    `mvp_worker.handlers.Handler` 协议：
16: 
17:    ```python
18:    class MyHandler:
19:        name = "my-handler"
20: 
21:        def validate(self, payload: object) -> None:
22:            # 用 jsonschema 严格校验 payload-<job>.json；
23:            # 未知 schema_version / 违反 schema → raise UnsupportedPayload
24:            # （错误消息只含 json_path + 关键字，禁止回显 payload 值）
25: 
26:        def handle(self, ctx: HandlerContext, job: JobRow) -> HandlerResult | None:
27:            # 1) 事务外做重活（算法/大模型/OSS）；每次外部调用边界检查
28:            #    ctx.abort_event —— 置位即立刻 return None（租约已丢，禁提交）
29:            # 2) 需要写业务表：把短事务回调放进 HandlerResult(business_tx=...)

32:            #    async_jobs → succeeded；守卫失败整体回滚（旧代次/旧输入的结果
33:            #    不发布，DD 8.1 锁顺序）
34:            # 3) 业务性失败 raise JobFailed(code, message, retryable=False/True)
35:    ```

37:    `register("<job_type>", my_handler_module.handler)`。

39:    - `async_jobs` 的租约/状态字段（由运行时统一写，handler 不直接写）；

29: BusinessTx = Callable[[Connection], None]

31: _COMPLETE_SUCCESS = text(

49:     available_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => :delay_seconds),
50:     last_error = CAST(:last_error AS jsonb),

70: def backoff_seconds(
71:     attempt_count: int,
72:     *,

79:     attempt_count 为本次已消耗的尝试数（claim 时递增，最小 1）。
80:     dev 初值 5s→300s（decisions #13）。

82:     r = rng or random
83:     exp = min(float(base_seconds) * (2 ** max(int(attempt_count) - 1, 0)), float(cap_seconds))

87: def make_last_error(
88:     code: str, message: str, *, retryable: bool, retry_after_seconds: Optional[int] = None

96:         err["retry_after_seconds"] = int(retry_after_seconds)

100: def complete_success(
101:     engine: Engine,
102:     claim: JobRow,
103:     *,

8: 
9: import logging

11: from typing import Optional

14:

20: 
21: class LostLease(RuntimeError):
22:     """当前代次不再持有有效租约（被回收/代次不符/已过期）。禁止提交结果。"""
23: 
24: 
25: _RENEW = text(
26:     """
27: UPDATE async_jobs
28: SET lease_until = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => :lease_seconds),
29:     updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
30: WHERE id = :id
31:   AND status = 'running'
32:   AND lease_owner = :worker_id
33:   AND lease_revision = :lease_revision
34:   AND lease_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
35: """
36: )
37: 
38: 
39: def renew(
40:     engine: Engine,
41:     job_id: str,
42:     lease_owner: str,
43:     lease_revision: int,
44:     *,
45:     lease_seconds: int,
46: ) -> bool:
47:     """成功延长租约返回 True；代次/状态/时效任一不符抛 LostLease。"""
48:     with engine.begin() as conn:
49:         res = conn.execute(
50:             _RENEW,
51:             {
52:                 "id": job_id,
53:                 "worker_id": lease_owner,
54:                 "lease_revision": int(lease_revision),
55:                 "lease_seconds": int(lease_seconds),
56:             },
57:         )
58:     if res.rowcount == 0:
59:         raise LostLease(
60:             f"job {job_id} lease lost (owner={lease_owner}, revision={lease_revision})"
61:         )
62:     return True
63: 
64: 
65: class LeaseRenewer:
66:     """每领取任务一个后台续租看门狗：每 renew_interval 续租一次；
67:     LostLease → 置 abort_event（协作式），handler 线程应在提交前检查并停止。"""

69:     def __init__(

72:         claim: JobRow,
73:         *,
74:         lease_seconds: int,
75:         renew_interval_seconds: float,
76:         abort_event: threading.Event,

78:         self._engine = engine
79:         self._claim = claim
80:         self._lease_seconds = lease_seconds
81:         self._interval = float(renew_interval_seconds)

83:         self._stop = threading.Event()
84:         self._thread: Optional[threading.Thread] = None
85: 
86:     def start(self) -> "LeaseRenewer":
87:         self._thread = threading.Thread(
88:             target=self._run,
89:             name=f"lease-renew-{self._claim.id[:8]}",
90:             daemon=True,
91:         )
92:         self._thread.start()
93:         return self
94: 
95:     def stop(self) -> None:
96:         self._stop.set()
97:         if self._thread is not None:
98:             self._thread.join(timeout=5.0)
99: 
100:     def _run(self) -> None:
101:         claim = self._claim
102:         while not self._stop.wait(self._interval):
103:             try:
104:                 renew(

124:                     logging.ERROR,
125:                     "lease.renew_error",
126:                     workerId=claim.lease_owner,
127:                     **claim.log_fields(),
128:                     errorType="renew_exception",
129:                 )

7: 
8: import os

13: class StorageError(RuntimeError):
14:     pass
15:

17: class StoragePort(Protocol):
18:     def put(self, object_key: str, data: bytes) -> None: ...

32: class FilesystemStorageDouble:
33:     """根目录 ``${MVP_A_STORAGE_DEV_DIR:-/tmp/mvp-a-storage}`` 下的文件存储替身。
34: 
35:     **跨语言布局约定**：文件路径 = ``<root>/<object_key>`` 原样，与 Java
36:     ``FileSystemStorageDouble``（app.storage.dev-dir，env APP_STORAGE_DEV_DIR /
37:     MVP_A_STORAGE_DEV_DIR 双名兼容）字节一致——同 root 同 key 读写同一文件。
38:     key 视为相对路径；解析后必须仍在根目录内（防 ``..`` 逃逸）。
39:     """
40: 
41:     def __init__(self, root: str | os.PathLike[str] | None = None) -> None:
42:         base = root or os.environ.get("MVP_A_STORAGE_DEV_DIR", "/tmp/mvp-a-storage")
43:         self._root = Path(base).resolve()
44: 
45:     @property
46:     def root(self) -> Path:
47:         return self._root
48: 
49:     def _path(self, object_key: str) -> Path:
50:         candidate = (self._root / object_key).resolve()
51:         if self._root not in candidate.parents and candidate != self._root:
52:             raise StorageError(f"object key escapes storage root: {object_key!r}")
53:         return candidate
54: 
55:     def put(self, object_key: str, data: bytes) -> None:
56:         path = self._path(object_key)
57:         path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
58:         tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
59:         tmp.write_bytes(data)
60:         tmp.replace(path)  # 原子替换，避免读到半写对象
61: 
62:     def get(self, object_key: str) -> bytes:
63:         path = self._path(object_key)
64:         if not path.is_file():
65:             raise StorageError(f"object not found: {object_key!r}")
66:         return path.read_bytes()
67: 
68:     def delete(self, object_key: str) -> None:
69:         path = self._path(object_key)
70:         try:
71:             path.unlink()
72:         except FileNotFoundError:
73:             pass  # 删除幂等（补偿重试友好）
74: 
75:     def exists(self, object_key: str) -> bool:
76:         return self._path(object_key).is_file()

491: | analyzing | 身份可靠、指标和结果图均有效 | report_ready；一次提交报告、摘要、方案待办 |
492: | queued / analyzing | 可重试依赖失败 | 保持公开处理中，并暴露最小重试说明；T12 延后 |
493: | queued / analyzing | 尝试耗尽/不可恢复失败 | failed；无正式报告，不回退云台指针 |
494: | report_ready | 任意旧分析或补拍 | 不变；正式内容冻结 |
495: 
496: failed 不是 GET 重试入口；用户重新测肤使用 M3-A01 新任务。后台受控重试可以按新 processing_revision 重排非定稿任务，必须留操作依据；MVP 不新增公开重算 API。被替换的旧任务可以完成归档供已授权 APP 使用，Worker 从不修改 current_assessment_id。
497: 
498: ### 7.2 方案
499: 
500: 报告发布创建唯一 assessment_id 的 T06，初始 waiting_inputs。输入齐全后 generating，结果通过验证后 ready；终止失败为 failed。ready 的 N、参数、输入快照冻结；进度更新不改生成代次。
501: 
502: 只有一种微晶不意味着可以信任任意上报参数。MVP 建议用配置中经设备团队批准的单一能力基线，加合法 T04 观察确认；T06.input_snapshot 记录选用能力标识/修订及参数范围。基线未配置或观察不满足时保持 waiting_inputs。Worker 批量扫描等待方案与必要的能力行，在应用层匹配；能力补齐自动推进，不能等客户端 GET 才推进。
503: 
504: 一份报告只对应一个方案行。等待任务先按等待检查间隔再次安排，不把“正常缺少能力”消耗为算法调用失败。正式生成任务 dedup_key 包含 planId 和 generationRevision；重复能力上报不增加生成代次，ready 后不因观察变化重新生成。执行时校验当前微晶能力仍覆盖冻结参数，不满足则拒绝准入。
505: 
506: ### 7.3 执行
507: 
508: | 当前状态 | 接受条件 | 允许变化 |
509: |---|---|---|
510: | 无 | M4-A03 最终准入成功 | admitted，建立占用，未声称硬件运行 |
511: | admitted | 原控制端新鲜实际观察、核验关联仍适用 | running / paused / unknown / stopped |
512: | running | 原控制端有序实际观察 | paused / unknown / stopped，或保持 running |
513: | paused | 连续性未失效且核验仍适用，或 M4-A04 已通过新核验后收到有序运行观察 | running；也可 unknown / stopped |
514: | unknown | 新鲜实际暂停/停止观察 | paused / stopped；不得因重新联网直接 running |
515: | stopped | 记录已对账且收尾成功 | closed |
516: | closed | 合法迟到实际明细 | 只补账，状态不变 |
517: 
518: M4-A04 成功仅更新核验代次与摘要，仍保持 paused，直到客户端实际观察 running。连续性失效标志写入 latest_observation；只有新核验成功才消除该轮恢复要求。running 观察不具有推翻“需要重新核验”的权力。
519: 
520: K ≥ N 拒绝新准入和恢复，但它本身不伪造 stopped/closed。新鲜异常 running 观察可用于记录设备实际偏差并告警，不能作为后端允许继续的依据。未知状态由客户端报告或明确的服务端观察过期策略产生，不因云台心跳离线直接冒充微晶停止。
521: 
522: ## 8. 事务、行锁与关键 SQL
523: 
524: ### 8.1 锁顺序与事务入口
525: 
526: Java 用 TransactionTemplate 包住最终短事务，外部人脸、OSS、认证网络请求在事务外。[Spring 编程式事务说明](https://docs.spring.io/spring-framework/reference/data-access/transaction/programmatic.html)
527: 
528: 既有业务锁顺序保持云台 → 微晶 → 方案 → 执行 → 授权。本稿对其他参与表补充顺序：T13 请求行（仅本请求）→ T03 云台 → T04 微晶 → T05 测肤 → T01 成员 → T06 方案 → T07 执行 → T02 授权 → T09 目标 → T10 通知 → T11 图片 → T12 任务。同类多行按 ID 排序，只锁涉及的行。
529: 
530: Worker 领取/续租仅锁 T12 并立即提交，不能持 T12 再等待业务行；结果提交先业务行再 T12。先前读到的归属只用于确定锁对象，最终持锁后必须复核，不能用未锁快照跳过权限。跨表写入默认 READ COMMITTED + 行锁 + 唯一约束；允许有限重试纯事务死锁/序列化冲突，不自动重复外部调用。
531: 
532: 授权创建并发需处理 active 部分唯一冲突；最终定位已有 active 行并锁定复核，不能让撤销与迟到授权请求交错复活。每个成功授权请求的 T13 都记录其实际返回的 grantId，即使复用已有关系。撤销针对固定 grantId，不针对“这个成员所有未来授权”。
533: 
534: ### 8.2 新任务与新执行互斥
535: 
536: 新测肤：锁 T03 → 查询该云台 closed_at IS NULL 的 T07 → 有未收尾则拒绝 → 插 T05 → 换指针 → 入队 → T13 成功，一次提交。
537: 
538: 云台新执行也先锁同一 T03，并核对请求当前任务/代次。它与新测肤不会同时越过检查：先新测肤则旧任务准入失败；先执行则新测肤因未收尾拒绝。APP 在其他地方使用历史方案不通过该云台指针授权，不被云台换人删除历史进度。
539: 
540: ### 8.3 原子占用
541: 
542: ```sql
543: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_execution_open_microcrystal
544: ON care_executions (microcrystal_id)
545: WHERE closed_at IS NULL;
546: 
547: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_execution_open_gimbal
548: ON care_executions (controller_gimbal_id)
549: WHERE controller_gimbal_id IS NOT NULL AND closed_at IS NULL;
550: ```
551: 
552: 新执行在锁外完成当前核验，然后锁 T04、T06 等必要行，检查 ready、K<N、能力及授权/当前任务，插入 admitted 执行。即使两次初查都未占用，唯一约束仍只允许一个提交。约束冲突转换为 DEVICE_OCCUPIED，不向客户端泄露对方成员。[PostgreSQL 部分唯一索引](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/indexes-partial.html)
553: 
554: ### 8.4 次数账本事务
555: 
556: 1. 读取 T07 固定归属，认证原控制端；锁 T06，再锁 T07。业务读取权限与最小补传权限分别判断。
557: 2. 校验批次内重复 ID/序号及摘要；批量单表读取 T08 已有 ID 和同序号记录，检查两种唯一键是否冲突。两次批量 SELECT 可接受，不逐条 SELECT。
558: 3. 批次内完全相同的重复项折叠一次；同 ID 或同序号异内容整体拒绝。已有同内容记录记 duplicate，不再插入。
559: 4. 批量插入真正新增记录，只有实际新增集合的 count_delta 求和为 D。D=0 时不增加 K/progress_revision。
560: 5. 增加执行 accepted_count 和方案 completed_count，首次达标记录 completed_at；合并合法新观察；T13 成功与以上同事务提交。
561: 6. 提交成功后才生成 acknowledgedRecords；事务失败不确认任何新增记录。
562: 
563: ```sql
564: UPDATE care_plans
565: SET completed_count = completed_count + :delta,
566:     progress_revision = progress_revision + 1,
567:     completed_at = CASE
568:       WHEN completed_at IS NULL AND completed_count + :delta >= target_count
569:       THEN :received_at ELSE completed_at END,
570:     updated_at = :received_at
571: WHERE id = :plan_id AND generation_status = 'ready';
572: 
573: UPDATE care_executions
574: SET accepted_count = accepted_count + :delta,
575:     updated_at = :received_at
576: WHERE id = :execution_id;
577: ```
578: 
579: 仅当 D>0 执行上述汇总 SQL，期望各更新一行，否则整体回滚。closed 执行也可以执行计数 UPDATE，但不更新 status/closed_at。ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING 不能替代内容一致性检查；更换 client_record_id 但复用源序号仍须被识别。
580: 
581: ### 8.5 单表收尾核对
582: 
583: 锁方案/执行后对固定 epoch 使用：
584: 
585: ```sql
586: SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count,
587:        COALESCE(MAX(source_seq), 0) AS max_seq,
588:        COALESCE(SUM(count_delta), 0) AS total_count
589: FROM care_records
590: WHERE execution_id = :execution_id AND source_epoch = :epoch;
591: ```
592: 
593: 结合正序号约束、双重唯一键、固定 epoch，record_count=W 且 max_seq=W 才能证明 1..W 无缺口；total_count 必须等于 finalCount。SQL 不 JOIN。检查通过后 T07.status='closed'、closed_at 和 manifest 同事务提交，不删除占用记录。纯状态 stopped 不能通过索引释放占用。
594: 
595: ### 8.6 查询示例
596: 
597: ```sql
598: SELECT id FROM member_access_grants
599: WHERE account_id = :account_id AND member_id = :member_id AND status = 'active';
600: 
601: SELECT report_id, report_ready_at, report_summary, id
602: FROM skin_assessments
603: WHERE member_id = :member_id AND status = 'report_ready'
604:   AND (report_ready_at, id) < (:cursor_time, :cursor_id)
605: ORDER BY report_ready_at DESC, id DESC
606: LIMIT :fetch_size;
607: ```
608: 
609: 第一页省略游标谓词，fetch_size=limit+1，用多取一条判断 nextCursor。详情先读归属再验权或先读轻量归属再读正文；允许多一次 SQL，不把少 JOIN 误当成少鉴权。已授权的在途读取可能已发出，撤销无法收回已下载字节；撤销后新的请求必须读新权限。
610: 
611: ## 9. PostgreSQL 队列与 Python Worker
612: 
613: ### 9.1 工作项契约
614: 
615: | job_type | owner / input_revision | dedup_key | 结果事务 |
616: |---|---|---|---|
617: | assessment.analyze | assessment / processing_revision | assessment:{id}:{revision} | T05 当前版本结果；发布报告时 T06 待办与下一 T12 |
618: | identity.enroll | identity namespace 协调项；输入含候选任务版本 | 稳定登记请求键 | 登记对账阶段/人员引用，最终 T01/T05；不授予 T02 |
619: | plan.generate | plan / generation_revision | plan:{id}:{revision} | 只写 T06 生成字段/N，不写 K |
620: | notification.deliver | notification / 对应投递版本 | notification:{id} | T10 投递结果 |
621: | media.cleanup | media / 清理代次 | media:{id}:cleanup:{revision} | T11 删除状态与补偿结果 |
622: 
623: identity.enroll 是为跨系统注册对账细化的内部工作类型，复用 T12，不新增公开 API。内部 payload 示例：
624: 
625: ```json
626: {
627:   "schema_version": 1,
628:   "correlation_id": "logical-request-uuid",
629:   "assessment_id": "assessment-uuid",
630:   "photo_version": "2",
631:   "processing_revision": "2",
632:   "images": {"front": "media-uuid-1", "left": "media-uuid-2", "right": "media-uuid-3"},
633:   "provider_config_revision": "1"
634: }
635: ```
636: 
637: job_type/owner/input_revision 是列，payload 不再持有另一套权威租约状态。两端解析同一 JSON Schema 和示例；未知版本标 failed/UNSUPPORTED_CONTRACT，并隔离告警。队列不传照片、pickle、Java 对象、签名 URL、运行凭据。
638: 
639: ### 9.2 领取、续租和过期结果
640: 
641: ```sql
642: SELECT id FROM async_jobs
643: WHERE status = 'queued' AND available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
644: ORDER BY available_at, id
645: LIMIT :batch_size
646: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
647: ```
648: 
649: 随后同一事务按返回 ID 更新 running、lease_owner、lease_until、lease_revision+1、attempt_count+1；提交后调用外部服务。领取查询适用于队列，不用于普通业务“跳过被锁行”而漏读。[PostgreSQL SELECT 锁定语义](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/sql-select.html)
650: 
651: 续租仅当 id、status=running、lease_owner、lease_revision 匹配且原租约未过期时更新。到期回收条件更新为 queued 并使旧领取代次失效。完成阶段：先锁相关业务行，再锁 T12，检查当前领取者/代次/租约和业务版本；不满足就回滚业务写，不发布结果。成功同事务提交结果、任务 succeeded、后继任务。清理失败结果图时也必须先验证未发布引用。
652: 
653: 瞬时外部错误采用有限指数退避与抖动；不可靠身份/低质量不是无限重试网络错误，而是补拍或明确失败。同步请求和队列各有尝试上限。不宣称外部调用 exactly-once：允许重复计算，不允许重复正式归档。
654: 
655: ### 9.3 人脸身份归档与新人登记
656: 
657: 三视角先质量检查并确认同人，然后做受控范围 1:N。可靠匹配用 namespace + face_subject_ref 定位 T01；歧义不归档，未命中只成为新人候选。
658: 
659: 新人注册需要 namespace 级持久协调：复用 T12 的 identity.enroll 工作项，建议部分唯一索引约束同一 namespace 只有一条 queued/running/failed 未决登记工作；其他候选分析任务等待后重搜。登记工作先持久记录 candidate_entity_id、原任务/版本、阶段和供应商 request ID，再锁外调用。网络超时先按同 EntityId 查询对账，不生成另一 ID 盲目重试。
660: 
661: 供应商索引写入已可见、与当前输入/租约仍一致后，事务建立 T01 并关联 T05；如果任务输入已被补拍替换，不能把旧登记结果归给新照片。外部成功但业务取消的人员资源保留受控对账，确认无业务引用后再清理。登记结果未确认可见时，协调项保持阻塞/待对账状态，不能释放后立即登记另一份同人候选；失败状态也必须有防止跳过未决注册的持久标记。
662: 
663: 该串行协调处理工程竞态，不证明算法能完美区分新人。供应商可见性、自动新人判定阈值、活体条件未通过 PoC，则不得开启真实自动登记。已有成员的分析不必等待新人注册队列；没有公共全库搜索入口。
664: 
665: ### 9.4 报告发布与方案交接
666: 
667: 算法临时结果图下载需白名单来源/大小限制，转存 OSS 并验证可用后才发布。锁 T05 检查照片/处理代次，固定 member_id/report_id/report_payload/report_summary/report_photo_version；插唯一 T06 waiting_inputs；插后继工作项；标分析任务成功，一次 PG 提交。
668: 
669: 测肤与计划分别可失败。报告发布后立即查询，不等待方案；方案生成输入是冻结报告与批准能力快照。大模型输出严格结构校验：方案成员/来源由服务端赋值，N 是正整数，参数和单位均在批准范围；无效结果不发布 ready。重试不更新已 ready 的方案，不重置 K/completed_at/progress_revision。
670: 
671: ### 9.5 离线和通知
672: 
673: 扫描 T03 的过期 last_seen_at 候选，逐行短事务重检，创建一次离线 episode 并维护 active_incidents。新心跳恢复关闭 episode；同一异常重复心跳不创建新 episode。设备首次从未心跳的 unknown 不直接解释为“刚离线”。
674: 
675: 绑定/目标有效且异常仍在时，以 T10 复合唯一键创建每目标通知及 T12。无目标时不记 submitted；后续新目标登记或定期扫描仍可为当前异常补建通知。异常未恢复但改绑 B 时新建 B 的通知，旧 A 通知取消，不改收件人复用旧行。
676: 
677: 投递前先在锁外向会话提供方核实会话有效性；查询失败不投递。随后短事务按 T03 → T09 → T10 → T12 重检账号、binding_revision、destination_revision、session_ref 及 episode，确认仍与刚核实的会话相同；标 sending 后在锁外发送。拿到可信受理 ID 才记 submitted，只有可信送达回执才记 delivered。发送后崩溃的 unknown 优先查供应商回执，不无条件重发。
678: 
679: 检查后到外部发送之间仍存在解绑竞争，不能用长事务锁包住推送网络调用来掩盖。消息仅写“云台状态异常，请查看”，不含成员、照片或报告；已经受理的通知不承诺撤回。
680: 
681: ## 10. 图片存储、访问与补偿
682: 
683: ### 10.1 上传流程
684: 
685: 先在 T13 建立稳定请求，再插 T11.pending（尚未创建的任务/执行外键为空）；流式写 OSS，校验格式、尺寸、大小和内容摘要，再将 T11 标 available。最终业务事务只接纳当前请求对应、purpose 正确且 available 的图片，补齐归属。图片 available 不等于对用户可访问。
686: 
687: 补拍时新版本完整视角清单由服务端构造；跨请求复用仅允许同任务已接纳图片，不接受任意 mediaId 或任意 URL。M1/M4 核验入口本版采用当前上传，不开放客户任选历史对象再当作新采集。
688: 
689: 对象 key 建议 `environment/purpose/random-media-id`，不含姓名、手机号、成员可读名称。Web/Worker 使用最小权限运行凭据；PG 不存图片二进制，日志不输出对象访问凭据。连接中断或超限时终止上传并回收临时文件。
690: 
691: ### 10.2 图片读取基础 HTTP
692: 
693: 建议补充 `GET /api/v1/media/{mediaId}/content`，属于二进制基础协议，不占用现有 M1—M5 编号。业务响应返回同源 contentUrl，不直接返回永久 OSS URL。
694: 
695: 1. 认证主体；T11 读取对象状态、用途和归属。
696: 2. 只允许业务报告投影公开的展示图片；检查 T05 冻结报告中确实引用该 mediaId。核验图、临时未归档图不可凭上传者身份直接下载。
697: 3. APP 查 T02 有效关系；云台查 T03 当前任务。通过后流式读取私有 OSS。
698: 4. 返回实际图片 MIME、no-store、X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff；不重定向至长效签名地址。本版可不支持 Range，请求不因此绕过鉴权。
699: 5. OSS 不存在返回受控错误并告警，不把缺图当报告全文不存在，也不返回内部 bucket/key。

151: ### T01 `members`：成员宽表
152: 
153: | 字段 | 类型 | 含义与约束 |
154: |---|---|---|
155: | `id` | uuid PK | 成员 ID |
156: | `identity_namespace`, `face_subject_ref` | text | 算法身份库命名空间及稳定人员引用；可靠建档后必填，组合唯一 |
157: | `profile` | jsonb | 基本资料及已明确需要的属性；MVP 可为空对象，不预设身份证、家庭等资料 |
158: | `identity_summary` | jsonb | 建档时核验结论、算法版本、证据图片 ID；不保存对外可用的人脸检索凭据 |
159: | `created_from_assessment_id` | uuid FK | 首次可靠建档来源；与测肤任务归档关联在同一事务完成 |
160: | `status` | text | `active` / `disabled`；禁用是运维状态，不代替授权撤销 |
161: 
162: 算法已匹配可靠人员时复用成员；确定是新人员时才创建。匹配不确定不建成员、不把不确定报告归给账号。调研已确认阿里云等云服务提供稳定人员引用；推荐先验证阿里云 EntityId 映射及跨系统登记一致性。现有 face-insightface-server 的 name/文件名存在恢复缺陷，不能直接当稳定 ID。详见 [人脸服务调研与推荐方案](人脸服务调研与推荐方案-V1-MVP.md)。登记仍须验证串行查重及索引可见性，不能用照片哈希去重“同一个人”。候选范围不按云台绑定账号圈定，也不对客户端开放全库人脸检索。
163: 
164: ### T02 `member_access_grants`：授权关系
165: 
166: | 字段 | 类型 | 含义与约束 |
167: |---|---|---|
168: | `id` | uuid PK | 本次授权 ID，对应公开 `grantId` |
169: | `account_id`, `member_id` | uuid FK / uuid FK | 获得访问权的账号及成员 |
170: | `status` | text | `active` / `revoked` |
171: | `granted_at`, `revoked_at` | timestamptz | 撤销时间仅 revoked 时有值；没有自动过期时间 |
172: | `member_summary` | jsonb | 成员导航所需的最小展示快照；无已定义展示属性时为空对象，不重复报告数据 |
173: | `verification_summary` | jsonb | 核验结论、证据图片 ID、算法引用，限内部使用 |
174: | `source_request_id` | uuid FK UNIQUE | 创建该关系的原始逻辑请求 |
175: 
176: 关键约束：同一 `(account_id, member_id)` 最多一条 active 关系；用部分唯一索引实现。再次授权须经过新的有效人脸请求，创建新 `grantId`，旧 revoked 行不复活。活跃授权重复请求返回已有关系，不重复建行。
177: 
178: 索引：`(account_id, status, created_at DESC, id)` 支持 M1-A02；active 组合唯一索引支持权限校验。
179: 
180: 撤销成功后，后续报告、方案、记录和图片访问读取这张表的当前状态。不能只相信 JWT 中曾经有过的成员列表。原控制端可做必要记录同步/收尾，但不能借此返回撤销后的成员资料。
181: 
182: ## 6. M2：云台与微晶管理
183: 
184: ### T03 `gimbals`：云台宽表
185: 
186: | 字段 | 类型 | 含义与约束 |
187: |---|---|---|
188: | `id`, `serial_no` | uuid PK / text UNIQUE | 云台内部 ID、设备标识 |
189: | `auth_subject_ref`, `credential_version` | text / bigint | 设备凭据主体或验证材料引用、失效代次；不存明文设备密钥 |
190: | `bound_account_id` | uuid FK，可空 | 当前通知所属账号；为空即未绑定 |
191: | `binding_revision`, `bound_at` | bigint / timestamptz，可空 | 每次真实绑定/解绑递增 revision；时间为空表示当前未绑定 |
192: | `current_assessment_id` | uuid FK，可空 | 唯一当前测肤任务；只能指向本云台任务 |
193: | `current_assessment_revision` | bigint | 成功受理新任务时递增；恢复、轮询、旧请求重试不递增 |
194: | `last_seen_at` | timestamptz，可空 | 最后有效心跳的服务端接收时间 |
195: | `connection_status`, `status_revision` | text / bigint | 后端最新在线判断及状态变化代次 |
196: | `latest_observation`, `active_incidents` | jsonb | 最新已知状态、目前异常摘要及异常 episode ID；不是无限心跳历史 |
197: 
198: 绑定、解绑在云台行上串行执行；不把客户端查询到的“未绑定”当作写入依据。解绑检查账号和本次绑定 revision，旧解绑重试不能删掉后来的 B 绑定，也不能删掉 A 后来新建的一次绑定。绑定状态查询对他人仅返回“已绑定其他账号”。
199: 
200: `current_assessment_id` 是 M3 负责更新的逻辑字段，物理上借用云台这一行实现互斥。建议以 `(id, current_assessment_id)` 指向 `skin_assessments(gimbal_id, id)` 的组合外键，避免跨云台指错任务。先插入任务再更新指针，首次无任务允许 NULL。云台与任务存在循环引用，迁移先建两表再补外键。
201: 
202: 设备会话可先采用认证服务签发、结合 `credential_version` 验证的凭据，不新增每次连接表。配对证明必须由可信配对协议验证并防重放；签名/挑战不等于把 `gimbalId` 当证明。具体设备认证协议继续属于开发对接。
203: 
204: 索引：`bound_account_id`；`(connection_status, last_seen_at)` 供离线扫描。设备心跳丢失不说明微晶已停止，不释放 M4 占用。

206: ### T04 `microcrystals`：微晶宽表
207: 
208: | 字段 | 类型 | 含义与约束 |
209: |---|---|---|
210: | `id`, `serial_no` | uuid PK / text UNIQUE | 微晶标识 |
211: | `capabilities` | jsonb | 当前唯一类型的护理能力、参数范围、固件信息 |
212: | `latest_observation` | jsonb | 最近接受的连接和状态观察，不作为护理次数 |
213: | `observer_type`, `observer_ref` | text | 上报的 APP 安装实例或云台，来源由认证上下文确定 |
214: | `observation_epoch`, `observation_seq` | text / bigint | 来源会话与序号，隔离重连和乱序；不能跨不同来源比较裸序号 |
215: | `observed_at`, `received_at` | timestamptz | 客户端观察时间和服务器接收时间 |
216: 
217: 不在本表另外维护权威 `current_controller`，避免与执行表两份占用不同步。当前占用从 M4 未收尾执行查询；M2-A04 不能改变执行控制端。能力和状态来源应受已有连接证明约束，普通账号不能凭 ID 篡改任意微晶。
218: 
219: ## 7. M3：测肤任务与统一报告
220: 
221: ### T05 `skin_assessments`：测肤任务/报告宽表
222: 
223: | 字段 | 类型 | 含义与约束 |
224: |---|---|---|
225: | `id`, `gimbal_id` | uuid PK / uuid FK | 任务及创建云台 |
226: | `member_id` | uuid FK，可空 | 可靠识别完成后固定；未识别时不可作为成员历史返回 |
227: | `status` | text | `queued` / `analyzing` / `needs_retake` / `report_ready` / `failed` |
228: | `current_photo_version`, `processing_revision` | bigint | 当前输入版本、处理代次；过期结果提交必须被拦截 |
229: | `photo_versions` | jsonb | 三视角照片版本清单，含图片 ID、补拍要求、质量结论，不存图片二进制 |
230: | `identity_result` | jsonb | 匹配结论、算法引用、失败或不确定原因 |
231: | `report_id` | uuid UNIQUE，可空 | 报告公开标识，生成成功时赋值；API 的 reportId 不要求单独报告表 |
232: | `report_summary` | jsonb，可空 | 列表/任务状态用的简短结果摘要，与正式报告同事务生成，列表不读取完整大载荷 |

234: | `report_photo_version`, `report_ready_at` | bigint / timestamptz，可空 | 报告实际依据版本、就绪时间 |
235: | `failure_code`, `failure_detail` | text / jsonb，可空 | 最新处理失败摘要与是否可重试；不向客户端泄露内部诊断 |
236: | `source_request_id` | uuid FK UNIQUE | 受理任务的逻辑请求 |
237: 
238: 约束：report_ready 必须有成员、报告 ID、结果载荷和对应有效照片版本。不同照片版本的输入清单不可互相覆盖。照片清单示例：
239: 
240: ```json
241: {
242:   "schema_version": 1,
243:   "versions": [
244:     {
245:       "version": 1,
246:       "images": {"front": "media-uuid", "left": "media-uuid", "right": "media-uuid"},
247:       "quality": {"status": "needs_retake", "required_views": ["left"]}
248:     },
249:     {
250:       "version": 2,
251:       "images": {"front": "reused-media-uuid", "left": "new-media-uuid", "right": "reused-media-uuid"},
252:       "quality": {"status": "accepted", "required_views": []}
253:     }
254:   ]
255: }
256: ```
257: 
258: 每个版本记录完整有效视角集合；复用旧视角时显式引用，不让 Worker 猜测拼接。JSON 中的图片 ID 由服务端验证 T11 归属，客户端不能任意引用他人的图片。
259: 
260: 建议补拍只在当前任务允许补拍且尚未定稿时受理；已经用于生成方案/执行的定稿报告不原地修改，重新测肤建立新任务。这是保护单版本方案一致性的实现建议，需在详细接口状态机中明确，不把定稿后的重算默认为已支持能力。
261: 
262: APP full 与云台 brief 由同一报告按白名单投影，不保存两份独立报告。报告 ready 后立即可读，不等待 M4 方案生成。被新任务替换的旧任务可以继续归档供授权 APP 使用，但不得把云台指针改回旧任务。

264: 索引：`(member_id, report_ready_at DESC, id) WHERE report_id IS NOT NULL` 支持历史列表；`report_id UNIQUE` 支持详情；`(gimbal_id, id) UNIQUE` 支持当前任务组合外键。

268: ### T06 `care_plans`：方案与进度宽表
269: 
270: | 字段 | 类型 | 含义与约束 |
271: |---|---|---|
272: | `id`, `assessment_id`, `member_id` | uuid PK / uuid FK UNIQUE / uuid FK | 一个任务最多一个方案行，生成等待/失败也留在同一行 |
273: | `generation_status` | text | `waiting_inputs` / `generating` / `ready` / `failed` |
274: | `input_photo_version`, `generation_revision` | bigint | 依据的报告照片版本、异步生成代次 |

277: | `plan_payload` | jsonb，可空 | 护理说明、步骤、区域、参数；ready 后业务内容冻结 |

282: | `failure_detail` | jsonb，可空 | 生成失败摘要 |
283:

374: ## 10. 三张公共支撑表
375: 
376: ### T11 `media_objects`：OSS 图片元数据
377: 
378: | 字段 | 类型 | 含义与约束 |
379: |---|---|---|
380: | `id`, `bucket`, `object_key` | uuid PK / text / text | OSS 对象位置，`(bucket, object_key)` 唯一，key 由服务端生成 |
381: | `purpose` | text | `assessment_source` / `assessment_result` / `grant_face` / `execution_face` / `revalidation_face` |
382: | `assessment_id`, `photo_version`, `execution_id`, `request_id`, `member_id` | uuid / bigint，可空 | 显式业务归属；按 purpose 校验必需组合；关联列使用外键 |
383: | `uploader_type`, `uploader_ref` | text | 经认证的云台、APP 或 Worker；不等于访问权限 |
384: | `state` | text | `pending` / `available` / `failed` / `deleting` / `deleted` |
385: | `content_type`, `byte_size`, `content_hash` | text / bigint / text | 校验格式、大小、完整性；业务哈希不直接假设等于 OSS ETag |
386: | `storage_metadata`, `last_error` | jsonb | 必要存储信息、失败摘要 |
387: 
388: 已确认图片保留原则：报告展示所需图片随报告保存；人脸参考照片按算法需要保存；其余临时核验照片不默认长期保存。具体期限在真实用户试用前落实，清理不得破坏有效报告、身份参考或去重事实。
389: 
390: 对应范围：云台原图/补拍图；APP 授权和护理核验照片；算法输出的测肤结果图片。失败核验的照片也能通过 request_id 定位，不强行挂给一个未识别的成员。认证照片不因为账号有成员查看权就自动公开可读。
391: 
392: 推荐当前协议：业务请求携带照片，后端转存 OSS，不新增独立文件管理 API。上传前登记 pending 与 request_id；新任务/执行尚未创建时，相应业务外键允许为空，不能引用一个尚不存在的行。上传成功后确认 available，业务受理事务再补齐 assessment_id/execution_id 等归属并接纳为有效输入。available 只说明文件已存好，不等于已获业务访问权；未被受理的对象仍不可访问。报告结果图必须转存可控 OSS 对象后才发布，外部算法临时 URL 不能当永久结果。
393: 
394: 图片展示建议使用**每次读取都检查业务权限的鉴权代理**；后端读取 OSS 私有对象并返回，避免已签发长效链接绕过授权撤销/云台当前任务替换。禁用可被公共缓存继续提供的响应策略。已经下载到客户端的字节无法由数据库远程收回，APP 仍要清理入口和缓存。若采用短期 OSS 直链，必须另定撤销延迟及失效机制，不能宣称立即撤销已发链接。
395: 
396: 图片访问描述仍由现有业务 API 返回；代理图片的具体下载路由属于后续 HTTP 契约细化，不能把“27 个业务 API”误说成所有图片都已经有完整下载协议。
397: 
398: 索引：`(assessment_id, photo_version)`、`execution_id`、`request_id`、`(state, created_at)`。JSON 清单中的图片引用由同事务服务端检查；清理器只清理明确未被业务接纳的上传/失败结果，不能因为只查不到某一个外键就删除仍在 JSON 清单里的对象。
399: 
400: ### T12 `async_jobs`：可靠异步工作队列
401: 
402: | 字段 | 类型 | 含义与约束 |
403: |---|---|---|
404: | `id`, `job_type`, `dedup_key` | uuid PK / text / text UNIQUE | 如测肤分析、方案生成、通知投递、对象清理；逻辑工作唯一键 |
405: | `owner_type`, `owner_id`, `input_revision` | text / uuid / bigint | 业务对象和所处理输入代次；通用 owner 由服务端校验 |
406: | `payload` | jsonb | 最小必要工作参数与对象引用，不塞图片二进制 |
407: | `status`, `available_at` | text / timestamptz | `queued` / `running` / `succeeded` / `failed` / `cancelled`；最早可领取时间 |
408: | `attempt_count`, `max_attempts` | bigint | 尝试次数及配置上限；本文不预设具体重试次数 |
409: | `lease_owner`, `lease_until`, `lease_revision` | text / timestamptz / bigint | Worker 租约和领取代次；旧 Worker 无权覆盖新领取者结果 |
410: | `last_error`, `finished_at` | jsonb / timestamptz，可空 | 错误摘要和结束时间 |
411: 
412: Java 受理业务与插入工作项在同一个 PG 事务提交，因此不另建 outbox。Python Worker 在另一个事务消费与写回，不存在跨 Java/Python 的同一事务。两端遵循技术架构中的字段写入边界；Worker 生成方案不得覆盖 Java 入账的 K/完成时间。payload.schema_version 用于跨语言任务格式兼容，数据库结构由唯一迁移入口管理。Worker 短事务领取工作，外部算法/大模型/OSS 调用放在事务外；完成时核对业务输入版本、租约代次再提交。租约到期可重新领取，但不代表旧外部调用已取消，业务写回仍须防止过期结果覆盖。
413: 
414: 索引：`(status, available_at, id)`；`(status, lease_until)`。队列可用行锁跳过已被其他 Worker 领取的行；具体批量、超时与重试参数由开发配置。通知正文与投递结果在 T10，T12 只负责调度，不复制两套权威状态。
415: 
416: ### T13 `idempotency_requests`：逻辑写请求与最小核验留痕
417: 
418: | 字段 | 类型 | 含义与约束 |
419: |---|---|---|
420: | `id`, `principal_type`, `principal_id` | uuid PK / text / text | 内部请求 ID、认证主体；APP 主体应包含账号/安装实例作用域 |
421: | `operation`, `idempotency_key` | text | 操作类型及客户端稳定请求键 |
422: | `payload_hash` | text | 规范化业务参数及照片内容哈希，排除可变传输头 |
423: | `status` | text | `processing` / `succeeded` / `rejected` |
424: | `lease_until`, `attempt_revision` | timestamptz / bigint | 进程失败后的安全接管；旧处理者不能提交 |
425: | `resource_type`, `resource_id` | text / uuid，可空 | 实际创建/变更资源引用 |
426: | `result_summary`, `verification_summary` | jsonb | 最小结果与核验摘要；不缓存可绕过权限的完整报告、方案或长效图片链接 |
427: 
428: 唯一键：`(principal_type, principal_id, operation, idempotency_key)`。先鉴权，再查去重；同键不同内容冲突。创建资源和记录成功结果在同一业务事务提交。外部核验过程可位于事务外，但最终提交重新校验授权/当前任务/占用及处理代次。
429: 
430: 撤销后重放旧授权请求只定位旧 grant，不能新建或恢复关系；旧测肤请求重放不重新移动当前指针；旧执行请求重放不再次启动；旧绑定请求重放不跨新的 binding_revision 修改关系。需要返回的业务内容按**当前权限及生命周期**重建，不能机械返回旧的敏感成功响应。
431: 
432: 这张表不能按任意短 TTL 全删：会破坏“撤销后的旧请求不复活”等规则。MVP 保留请求键、摘要、资源引用等最小去重事实；大型核验诊断/照片的保留与去重键的保留分别处理。T08 每条记录的去重不能被请求级去重替代。

51: ## 4. 阿里云：可用能力与具体接法
52: 
53: ### 4.1 能力与 API
54: 
55: | 作用 | 接口 | 输入/产出与适配注意 |
56: |---|---|---|
57: | 建库与人员登记 | CreateFaceDb、AddFaceEntity、AddFace | 库内人员使用 EntityId，照片使用 FaceId；由后端维护成员映射 |
58: | 判断当前人员是谁 | SearchFace | 当前照片与指定库范围，返回候选人员、照片引用及相似度；不能拿最高分就无条件放行 |
59: | 判断是否方案本人 | CompareFace | 当前照片 + 该成员可信参考照片；本次核实接口不接收 EntityId 替代第二张图 |
60: | 图片活体检测 | DetectLivingFace | 图片静默活体，需和同一次身份采集绑定；不能视为已具备随机动作挑战 |
61: 
62: 依据：[AddFaceEntity](https://help.aliyun.com/en/viapi/developer-reference/api-add-face-entity)、[SearchFace](https://help.aliyun.com/en/viapi/developer-reference/api-t00lyd)、[CompareFace](https://help.aliyun.com/en/viapi/developer-reference/api-fomc02)、[DetectLivingFace](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/viapi/developer-reference/api-j81gjl)。
63: 
64: ### 4.2 三条业务链路
65: 
66: **云台测肤身份归档：**新测肤受理并转为唯一当前任务 → Python Worker 对固定照片版本做身份处理 → 查询云端人员库 → 可靠匹配则关联 member_id；不确定不归档；可靠新人候选经过查重和登记可见性确认后才完成成员建档。身份归档可随现有测肤异步任务处理，不新增云台历史识别入口。
67: 
68: **APP 获取查看授权：**已登录账号发起本次受控采集 → Java 同步调用人脸能力识别已有成员 → 通过业务检查后写 member_access_grants。未匹配不建成员，旧请求不能复活已撤销授权。
69: 
70: **护理开始/恢复：**Java 读取方案所属 member_id 及可信参考照 → 当前照片与参考照调用 CompareFace → 通过后在短事务中重检权限、当前任务与微晶占用 → 登记/恢复原执行。同步请求不排入 Worker 队列等待；旧核验结果不能跨成员、执行和采集会话复用。
71: 
72: Java/Python 都经各自适配代码调用同一约定的云服务，不要求共用可执行代码；共同遵守人员引用、状态、版本及照片用途契约。参考照由私有 OSS 保存和受控读取，不能由客户端任意提交第二张图决定“本人是谁”。
73: 
74: ### 4.3 尚需验证的地方
75: 
76: - 云台与 Android 手机跨设备识别、不同光照/角度/妆容下的通过率、错认与不确定情况。
77: - 静态活体是否足以满足实际采集环境，是否需要另外接入 APP SDK/视频挑战；不能把云 API 调用 SDK 当作摄像头活体 SDK。
78: - 单人质量准入。部分接口自动选择最大脸不等于业务已经排除了多人混入。
79: - 人员登记与索引生效延迟、请求超时后的对账、并发注册防重；不推定供应商具备全局自然人原子去重。
80: - 实际库容量、调用额度、完整链路费用及数据处理/删除条款。AddFaceEntity 文档列有容量约束及长期未调用特征冻结策略，稳定 ID 不代表算法资源永远可用。[官方限制与生命周期](https://help.aliyun.com/en/viapi/developer-reference/api-add-face-entity)

190: ## 6. 对当前数据架构的建议
191: 
192: 当前云服务路线的原则：继续 14 张业务表和宽表设计，**不因为调研发现一人多图就立即新增人脸照片表、向量库或身份映射服务**。以下为实施前字段细化建议，不是已经执行的数据库迁移。
193: 
194: | 位置 | 建议 | 理由 |
195: |---|---|---|
196: | members.id / member_id | 保持后端自有成员主键 | 不依赖云厂商实体或本地 name 的生命周期 |
197: | members.face_subject_ref | 阿里云接入时明确保存 EntityId；若改名为 face_person_id，统一替换而不同时保留两个同义字段 | 人员引用不等于 FaceId 或照片 URL |
198: | identity_namespace | 当前按单库配置维护；若沿用已有列，写入统一且可追溯的配置引用 | 单库不需要多库管理界面；更换库不能让旧映射被误解释 |
199: | members.identity_summary | 增加结构化的登记状态、配置/策略版本、可信参考图 media ID，必要时保留少量 FaceId 清单 | 初期利用已有 JSONB 宽表，避免拆分多张从属表 |
200: | media_objects | 沿用现有对象表记录图片和成员/请求归属 | 参考照与临时核验照应在用途/保留策略上区分；目的枚举在实施前同步细化 |
201: | idempotency_requests / async_jobs | 复用请求、任务去重与登记对账信息 | 云端成功、PG 未提交时可恢复同一人员，不盲目重建 |
202: | member_access_grants | 保持现有授权表与撤销规则 | 不沿用调研草稿中的 account_member_access 等其他命名，避免重复造表 |
203: 
204: 未确认身份的测肤任务保持 member_id 为空。云端入库与 PG 不存在共同事务，应以预先确定的人员引用和幂等键对账；在身份可用前不开放授权或护理。后端串行注册也不能单独消除外部索引延迟，需要确认写入可见后再结束登记流程。
205: 
206: 删除算法模板、撤销账号查看权和删除业务成员是三件不同的事，不能互相隐式触发。继续沿用已确定的图片保留原则：报告用图随报告、参考照按算法需要、临时核验照不默认长期保留。
207: 
208: ## 7. MVP 接入建议与验证顺序
209: 
210: ### 7.1 第一阶段：验证能力，不扩大业务范围
211: 
212: 以阿里云测试库和经授权的测试照片验证现有完整用例；固定服务配置、阈值策略和采集流程，记录真实设备结果。已有成员识别与自动建档分别验收，自动建档未验证通过不能假装已覆盖该用例。
213: 
214: 不新增人工选人、人工强制通过、后台合并成员、多云自动切换、多个模型并跑等产品流程。无法可靠判断时沿用补拍/重试或失败状态；是否需要额外例外流程以后单独评估。

93:         ).start()

95:             result = handler.handle(ctx, claim)
96:         except JobFailed as exc:

98:             return
99:         except Exception as exc:  # 未预期异常 → 按临时错误退避重试
100:             mlog(log, logging.ERROR, "job.handler_exception",
101:                  workerId=worker_id, **fields, errorClass=type(exc).__name__)
102:             self._finish_failure(
103:                 claim, "HANDLER_ERROR", f"unhandled {type(exc).__name__}", retryable=True
104:             )

106:         finally:

109:         if abort_event.is_set():
110:             # 租约已丢：结果不提交、不作废（回收器已/将重新入队，新代次接管）
111:             mlog(log, logging.WARNING, "job.result_abandoned_lease_lost",
112:                  workerId=worker_id, **fields)

114:         try:
115:             complete_success(

117:                 claim,

120:         except StaleGeneration:

122:                  workerId=worker_id, **fields,
123:                  note="rolled back; recovery owns the job now")

125:         mlog(log, logging.INFO, "job.succeeded", workerId=worker_id, **fields)

1: """过期回收（recovery）与优雅停机释放。
2: 
3: 回收器用条件更新把租约过期的 running 任务转回 queued 并递增 lease_revision，
4: 使旧领取者的代次整体失效——绝不"只查时间后无条件覆盖新领取者"（DD 9.2）。
5: available_at 不改（失败重试路径已按退避设置过）。
6: 
7: 重试上限（oracle M7）：回收时若 `attempt_count >= max_attempts`（崩溃/超时
8: 循环已耗尽预算），不再重排队，改条件更新落终态 failed + RETRY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
9: last_error；否则旧领取者过期后任务被无限重放。两条 UPDATE 各自带
10: `status='running' AND lease_until < now` 代次守护，同一事务内先判定终态、
11: 后回收仍有预算的行，互斥不重复计数。
12: """
13: from __future__ import annotations
14: 
15: from sqlalchemy import Engine, text
16: 
17: from .rows import JobRow
18: 
19: # 已达上限：过期 running → failed 终态（RETRY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED），不再回队列。
20: _FAIL_AT_CEILING = text(
21:     """
22: UPDATE async_jobs
23: SET status = 'failed',
24:     finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
25:     lease_owner = NULL,
26:     lease_until = NULL,
27:     last_error = jsonb_build_object(
28:         'code', 'RETRY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED',
29:         'message', 'attempt ceiling reached via lease expiry; re-enroll needed for retry',
30:         'retryable', false),
31:     updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
32: WHERE status = 'running' AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
33:   AND attempt_count >= max_attempts
34: RETURNING id
35: """
36: )
37: 
38: # 仍有预算：过期 running → queued（代次 +1 使旧领取者失效）
39: _RECOVER_EXPIRED = text(
40:     """
41: UPDATE async_jobs
42: SET status = 'queued',
43:     lease_owner = NULL,
44:     lease_until = NULL,
45:     lease_revision = lease_revision + 1,
46:     updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
47: WHERE status = 'running' AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
48:   AND attempt_count < max_attempts
49: RETURNING id
50: """
51: )
52: 
53: _RELEASE = text(
54:     """
55: UPDATE async_jobs
56: SET status = 'queued',
57:     lease_owner = NULL,
58:     lease_until = NULL,
59:     lease_revision = lease_revision + 1,
60:     updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
61: WHERE id = :id AND status = 'running'
62:   AND lease_owner = :worker_id AND lease_revision = :lease_revision
63:   AND attempt_count < max_attempts
64: """
65: )
66: 
67: # 优雅停机释放时已触顶：交还队列只会滞留（claim 条件不再领取），直接落 failed 终态。
68: _RELEASE_FAIL = text(
69:     """
70: UPDATE async_jobs
71: SET status = 'failed',
72:     finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
73:     lease_owner = NULL,
74:     lease_until = NULL,
75:     last_error = jsonb_build_object(
76:         'code', 'RETRY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED',
77:         'message', 'graceful release at attempt ceiling',
78:         'retryable', false),
79:     updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
80: WHERE id = :id AND status = 'running'
81:   AND lease_owner = :worker_id AND lease_revision = :lease_revision
82:   AND attempt_count >= max_attempts
83: """
84: )
85: 
86: 
87: def recover_expired(engine: Engine) -> int:
88:     """回收所有租约过期任务：有预算→重排队（代次+1），触顶→failed 终态。
89: 
90:     返回处理条数（两者之和）。幂等条件更新，可任意频率运行（oracle M7）。
91:     """
92:     with engine.begin() as conn:
93:         failed = conn.execute(_FAIL_AT_CEILING).fetchall()
94:         requeued = conn.execute(_RECOVER_EXPIRED).fetchall()
95:     return len(requeued) + len(failed)
96: 
97: 
98: def release_claim(engine: Engine, claim: JobRow, *, worker_id: str) -> bool:
99:     """优雅停机 best-effort：仍持有当前代次时主动交还给 queued（代次递增，
100:     自身后续提交必然 StaleGeneration）；已触顶则落 failed 终态而非滞留队列。
101:     返回是否成功处理。"""
102:     with engine.begin() as conn:
103:         res = conn.execute(
104:             _RELEASE,
105:             {"id": claim.id, "worker_id": worker_id, "lease_revision": claim.lease_revision},
106:         )
107:         if res.rowcount > 0:
108:             return True
109:         res = conn.execute(
110:             _RELEASE_FAIL,
111:             {"id": claim.id, "worker_id": worker_id, "lease_revision": claim.lease_revision},
112:         )
113:     return res.rowcount > 0

1: """命令行入口：``python -m mvp_worker``。
2:

4:   SIGTERM/SIGINT 优雅停机（停止领取，等待在途完成事务；未完成者由租约回收接管）。
5: - ``--check``：连接 PostgreSQL 打印服务端版本后退出（骨架自检行为，保持不变）。
6: - ``--once``：单周期 claim/dispatch/complete 后退出 0（跨语言 E2E 测试用；
7:   不启动健康端点，避免测试端口冲突）。
8: - ``--recover``：执行一次过期回收并打印条数。
9: """

11: 
12: import argparse

27:         row = cur.execute("SHOW server_version").fetchone()
28:     print(f"PostgreSQL server_version: {row[0] if row else 'unknown'}")
29:     return 0
30: 
31: 
32: def _run_recover(cfg: WorkerConfig) -> int:
33:     from .runtime.expire import recover_expired
34: 
35:     from .db import create_db_engine
36: 
37:     engine = create_db_engine(
38:         cfg.runtime_dsn, pool_size=1, max_overflow=cfg.max_overflow
39:     )
40:     try:
41:         count = recover_expired(engine)
42:     finally:
43:         engine.dispose()
44:     print(f"recovered_expired_jobs: {count}")
45:     return 0
46: 
47: 
48: def _run_once(cfg: WorkerConfig) -> int:
49:     from .runtime.loop import WorkerRuntime
50: 
51:     rt = WorkerRuntime(cfg)
52:     try:
53:         processed = rt.run_cycle()
54:     finally:
55:         rt.dispose()
56:     print(f"once_cycle_processed_jobs: {processed}")
57:     return 0
58: 
59: 
60: def _run_forever(cfg: WorkerConfig) -> int:
61:     from .db import create_db_engine
62:     from .health import start_health_server
63:     from .runtime.loop import WorkerRuntime
64: 
65:     engine = create_db_engine(
66:         cfg.runtime_dsn, pool_size=cfg.pool_size, max_overflow=cfg.max_overflow
67:     )
68:     rt = WorkerRuntime(cfg, engine=engine)

71:     def _stop(signum: int, _frame: object) -> None:
72:         mlog(log, logging.INFO, "worker.signal_stop",

74:         rt.stop_event.set()
75: 
76:     signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, _stop)
77:     signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, _stop)
78:     try:
79:         rt.run_forever()
80:     finally:
81:         server.shutdown()
82:         server.server_close()
83:         engine.dispose()
84:     return 0
85: 
86: 
87: def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
88:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="mvp_worker")
89:     parser.add_argument(
90:         "--check",
91:         action="store_true",
92:         help="连接 PostgreSQL、打印服务端版本并退出（不启动运行循环）",
93:     )

```python
_INSERT = text("""INSERT INTO async_jobs (...) VALUES (...) ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id""")
_SELECT_BY_DEDUP = text("SELECT id FROM async_jobs WHERE dedup_key=:k")

class EnrollSlotOccupied(RuntimeError): pass

def insert_job(conn, *, job_type, dedup_key, owner_type, owner_id, input_revision, payload, available_at=None, max_attempts=None) -> tuple[str,bool]:
    # returns (id, replayed); may raise IntegrityError
    ...
    row = conn.execute(_INSERT, {...}).first()
    if row is None:
        existing = conn.execute(_SELECT_BY_DEDUP, {"k": dedup_key}).first()
        return str(existing[0]), True
    return str(row[0]), False

def enqueue_job(engine, **kw) -> tuple[str,bool]:
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        return insert_job(conn, **kw)

def enqueue_identity_enroll(engine, **kw) -> tuple[str,bool]:
    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            return insert_job(conn, **kw)
    except IntegrityError as exc:
        if _is_enroll_slot_conflict(exc):
            raise EnrollSlotOccupied() from exc
        raise
```

payload 一律 dict 且 ``schema_version`` 必须为 JSON 整数（T12 CHECK 要求 object 且

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Optional

from sqlalchemy import Connection, Engine, text
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError

from ...config import WorkerConfig

_INSERT_JOB = text(
    """
INSERT INTO async_jobs (id, job_type, dedup_key, owner_type, owner_id, input_revision,
                        payload, status, available_at, attempt_count, max_attempts,
                        lease_revision, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), :job_type, :dedup_key, :owner_type, CAST(:owner_id AS uuid),
        :input_revision, CAST(:payload AS jsonb), 'queued',
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => :delay_seconds),
        0, :max_attempts, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id
"""
)

_SELECT_BY_DEDUP = text("SELECT id FROM async_jobs WHERE dedup_key = :dedup_key")


class EnrollSlotOccupied(RuntimeError):
    """namespace 级 identity.enroll 未决槽已被占用（uq_job_identity_enroll）。"""


def _is_enroll_slot_conflict(exc: IntegrityError) -> bool:
    orig = getattr(exc, "orig", None)
    diag = getattr(orig, "diag", None)
    name = getattr(diag, "constraint_name", None) if diag is not None else None
    if name == "uq_job_identity_enroll":
        return True
    return "uq_job_identity_enroll" in str(exc)


def insert_job(
    conn: Connection,
    *,
    job_type: str,
    dedup_key: str,
    owner_type: str,
    owner_id: str,
    input_revision: int,
    payload: dict[str, Any],
    available_at_delay_seconds: float = 0.0,
    max_attempts: Optional[int] = None,
) -> tuple[str, bool]:
    """在调用方事务内插入（或按 dedup_key 复用）一行 queued 任务。

    返回 ``(job_id, replayed)``：dedup 冲突 = 同一逻辑任务重放（不是错误）。
    可能向上抛 ``IntegrityError``（如 identity 部分唯一索引）；调用方决定语义。
    """
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("job payload must be a JSON object")
    schema_version = payload.get("schema_version")
    if not isinstance(schema_version, int) or isinstance(schema_version, bool):
        raise ValueError("job payload must carry an integer schema_version")
    attempts = max_attempts if max_attempts is not None else WorkerConfig().retry_max_attempts
    row = conn.execute(

"""结果图归档：算法输出图 → 受控 T11 ``assessment_result`` 行 + 存储对象。

流程（DD 9.4 / 10.1）：先按 ``assessment_id + photo_version + purpose`` 单表读取
既有结果图，用 ``storage_metadata->>'provider_ref'`` 匹配复用（至少一次重跑不产生
孤儿重复）；否则插 pending 行 → 存储 put（事务外）→ 置 available（内容类型/大小/
摘要）。任何归档失败都**不发布报告**，由 handler 决定可重试或终止。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import uuid
from typing import Any, Optional

from sqlalchemy import Engine, text

from ...media.storage import build_object_key
from .constants import ALLOWED_RESULT_CONTENT_TYPES, DEFAULT_BUCKET

_SELECT_RESULT_MEDIA = text(
    """
SELECT id, object_key, state, content_type, byte_size, storage_metadata
FROM media_objects
WHERE assessment_id = CAST(:assessment_id AS uuid)
  AND photo_version = :photo_version
  AND purpose = 'assessment_result'
"""
)

_INSERT_RESULT_MEDIA = text(
    """
INSERT INTO media_objects (id, bucket, object_key, purpose, assessment_id, photo_version,
                           member_id, uploader_type, state, storage_metadata,
                           created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (CAST(:id AS uuid), :bucket, :object_key, 'assessment_result',
        CAST(:assessment_id AS uuid), :photo_version, NULL, 'worker', 'pending',
        CAST(:storage_metadata AS jsonb), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
"""
)

_UPDATE_MEDIA_AVAILABLE = text(
    """
UPDATE media_objects
SET state = 'available', content_type = :content_type, byte_size = :byte_size,
    content_hash = :content_hash, storage_metadata = CAST(:storage_metadata AS jsonb),
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = CAST(:id AS uuid) AND state IN ('pending', 'available')
"""
)


class ArchiveError(RuntimeError):
    """结果图归档失败；``terminal`` 表示重试无法恢复。"""

    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str, *, terminal: bool) -> None:
        super().__init__(f"{code}: {message}")
        self.code = code
        self.message = message
        self.terminal = terminal


def sniff_content_type(data: bytes) -> Optional[str]:
    if data.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"):
        return "image/png"
    if data.startswith(b"\xff\xd8\xff"):
        return "image/jpeg"
    if data[:4] == b"RIFF" and data[8:12] == b"WEBP":
        return "image/webp"
    return None


def _load_by_ref(engine: Engine, assessment_id: str, photo_version: int) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            _SELECT_RESULT_MEDIA,
            {"assessment_id": assessment_id, "photo_version": int(photo_version)},
        ).mappings().all()
    by_ref: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for row in rows:
        meta = row["storage_metadata"] or {}
        ref = meta.get("provider_ref") if isinstance(meta, dict) else None
        if isinstance(ref, str) and ref and ref not in by_ref:
            by_ref[ref] = dict(row)
    return by_ref


def archive_result_images(
    engine: Engine,
    storage: Any,
    *,
    environment: str,
    assessment_id: str,
    photo_version: int,
    result_images: list[dict[str, Any]],
    max_bytes: int,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """归档结果图；返回 ``[{"media_id","caption","content_type"}]``（保序）。"""
    by_ref = _load_by_ref(engine, assessment_id, photo_version)
    archived: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for image in result_images:
        if not isinstance(image, dict):
            raise ArchiveError("RESULT_ARCHIVE_FAILED", "result image not an object", terminal=True)
        ref = image.get("ref")
        caption = image.get("caption", "")
        data = image.get("bytes")
        if not isinstance(ref, str) or not ref:
            raise ArchiveError("RESULT_ARCHIVE_FAILED", "result image missing ref", terminal=True)
        if not isinstance(caption, str):
            raise ArchiveError("RESULT_ARCHIVE_FAILED", "result image caption not a string", terminal=True)
        if not isinstance(data, (bytes, bytearray)):
            raise ArchiveError(
                "RESULT_ARCHIVE_FAILED", "result image bytes missing", terminal=True
            )
        data = bytes(data)
        if len(data) > int(max_bytes):
            raise ArchiveError("RESULT_ARCHIVE_FAILED", "result image exceeds size cap", terminal=True)
        content_type = sniff_content_type(data)
        if content_type not in ALLOWED_RESULT_CONTENT_TYPES:
            raise ArchiveError(
                "RESULT_ARCHIVE_FAILED", "result image content type not allowed", terminal=True
            )

        existing = by_ref.get(ref)
        if (
            existing is not None
            and existing.get("state") == "available"
            and existing.get("content_type") == content_type
            and existing.get("byte_size") == len(data)
        ):
            archived.append(
                {"media_id": str(existing["id"]), "caption": caption, "content_type": content_type}
            )
            continue

        if existing is None:
            media_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
            object_key = build_object_key(environment, "assessment_result", media_id)
            meta = {"schema_version": 1, "provider_ref": ref}
            with engine.begin() as conn:
                conn.execute(
                    _INSERT_RESULT_MEDIA,
                    {
                        "id": media_id,
                        "bucket": DEFAULT_BUCKET,
                        "object_key": object_key,
                        "assessment_id": assessment_id,
                        "photo_version": int(photo_version),
                        "storage_metadata": _json(meta),
                    },
                )
            row = {
                "id": media_id,
                "object_key": object_key,
                "state": "pending",
                "content_type": None,
                "byte_size": None,
                "storage_metadata": meta,
            }
            by_ref[ref] = row
            existing = row
        else:
            media_id = str(existing["id"])
            object_key = str(existing["object_key"])

        try:
            storage.put(object_key, data)
        except Exception as exc:  # 存储瞬时不可用 → 可重试；pending 行保留待复用
            raise ArchiveError(
                "RESULT_ARCHIVE_FAILED", "storage put failed", terminal=False
            ) from exc

        meta = {"schema_version": 1, "provider_ref": ref}
        digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            conn.execute(
                _UPDATE_MEDIA_AVAILABLE,
                {
                    "id": media_id,
                    "content_type": content_type,
                    "byte_size": len(data),
                    "content_hash": digest,
                    "storage_metadata": _json(meta),
                },
            )
        existing.update({"state": "available", "content_type": content_type, "byte_size": len(data)})
        archived.append({"media_id": media_id, "caption": caption, "content_type": content_type})

    return archived


def _json(value: Any) -> str:
    import json

    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)
